answer: Locks are written down in signal, expire in forge, and delta lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 40 aliases hence needs 57 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1956 identities would post 1160 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
